hook: Are you skipping warm-up and cool-down during workouts? Here is why it harms your body!
caption:
Do you skip Warm-up & Cool-down? 🚨 Here is why your muscles need it!

Skipping warm-up causes muscle stiffness and increases risk of tears, while skipping cool-down leads to intense soreness (DOMS) and dizziness!

💡 Simple Daily Routine:
1️⃣ 5 mins Dynamic Warm-up (Arm circles, leg swings, light jog)
2️⃣ Main Workout
3️⃣ 5 mins Cool-down (Static stretches & deep breathing)

Protect your joints and muscles every day! 💪

#FitnessTelugu #WarmUp #CoolDown #WorkoutTips #TeluguHealth #HealthTipsTelugu #GymMotivation #InjuryPrevention
poster_caption:
Skipping your warm-up and cool-down is costing you gains and setting you up for injury. 🏋️‍♂️⚡

Here is how to optimize your workout transitions:

• 01: Dynamic movement primes your joints with lubricating synovial fluid.
• 02: Cold muscles lack elasticity, dramatically increasing injury risk.
• 03: Post-workout cool-downs kickstart muscle repair by lowering cortisol.

📌 Save this guide for your daily health routine!
